newsitem.title: FINLAND: Raisio still talking on Benecol partner.
newsitem.headline: Raisio still talking on Benecol partner.

text.p: Finnish food, feed and chemicals group Raisio Yhtyma Oy said on Thursday it was still in talks on a partnership to launch its Benecol margarine overseas, but gave no timetable for agreement.
"We are negotiating both in the U.S. and in Europe on launching the product abroad," Raisio spokesman Sten von Hellens told Reuters. "The talks are in a stage where anything is possible," he said.
A feasibility study in the United States on a plant to produce the key ingredient of its cholesterol-reducing Benecol margarine will be completed in early autumn, he added.
Raisio's stock, volatile since overseas investors moved in amid high hopes for Benecol margarine, fell sharply in Helsinki on Thursday, losing 23 markka to 357.00 in lively 37 million markka volume.

Von Hellens was speaking after brokers and analysts said some investors were tiring of waiting for progress in the overseas development of Raisio's Benecol business. Brokers said a large U.S. investor was a seller on Thursday.
